text:
Rae: Quick thread to lock down Slate partner incentive structure + feedback triage flow. Goal: get 4 high-quality integrations in 8 weeks.
Leo: What's the incentive ladder? Need clear numbers for finance.
Rae: Proposal: Bronze: $1k credits + priority support office hours; Silver: $5k credits + 2 onboarding sessions + co-dev PR; Gold: $20k credits + dedicated SRE hours + feature prioritization slot.
Priya: Make Gold invite-only and require a 6-week onboarding commitment. Also require a short case study (anonymized ok) for Gold partners.
Tom: For on-prem partners we should add an install stipend to Gold (one-time $7k) for ops time.
Jamal: Security guardrails: intake must record data sensitivity, required KMS/HSM, and whether logs can be sent to Redwood. If partner is high-sensitivity, require NDA addendum and pre-onboard security review.
Rae: Feedback collection: use a single in-console tag `dp:slate` + one-click export that populates a triage board. We should capture fields: reproducible (y/n), severity (1-5), business_impact (low/med/high), suggested_fix.
dp-bot: New intake form published: https://internal.redwood/dp/slate-intake (auto-tag: dp:slate).
Priya: Scoring idea (simple):
```
score = (3 if reproducible == "yes" else 0) + (2 if severity >= 4 else 1 if severity == 3 else 0) + (2 if business_impact == "high" else 1 if business_impact == "med" else 0)
```
Map: 6-7 => P0, 4-5 => P1, <=3 => backlog/watch.
Leo: Let's also weight partner ROI: multiply score by 1.2 if Gold, 1.1 if Silver, 1.0 if Bronze when computing absolute priority.
Tom: Onboarding checklist (2 weeks for Bronze/Silver, 4 weeks for Gold): access + API keys, sample dataset + eval prompts, run baseline evals, end-to-end smoke test, paging contact. I can draft templates.
Rae: Success criteria to keep partner in active cohort: 1) integration sends >=10 valid calls/day by week 4 OR 2) demonstrates daily eval runs with stability metrics improving. If neither met by day 30, we offer self-serve downgrade.
Jamal: Infra gating: Dedicated sizing targets for Gold: target median p50 latency <= 120ms for production traffic at partner 95th percentile QPS. Need Chris (SRE sizing) numbers but we can estimate now.
Priya: Quality regression gate: must not degrade partner's baseline accept rate by >2% across rolling 24h. If regression, auto-rollback + hotfix window.
Rae: Rollout plan: week 0-2 onboard 2 Gold pilot partners (internal), week 3-6 onboard first 3 external Gold, staggered Silvers across weeks 4-10. Keep 1 SRE on-call for each Gold onboarding.
Tom: Measurement: NPS after 30 days, regen_rate, false_positive_rate, time_to_first_success. We'll store all evals tagged with partner ID for future analysis.
Leo: Cost model: approximate monthly cost per active partner: Bronze $200, Silver $900, Gold $3,500 (includes amortized SRE time and credits). Finance sign-off needed.
Rae: Action items: @Leo confirm finance numbers; @Tom draft onboarding templates; @Jamal add security intake fields + quick review checklist; @Priya build scoring rubric into triage board; @Rae publish intake link and partner FAQ. Reconvene Friday to approve final terms.
Priya: I'll mock up the triage board today and push sample exports to GH issues.
Jamal: Security checklist queued. Will add KMS checkbox and data retention limits.
Tom: I'll post the onboarding playbook by EOD tomorrow.
Rae: Thanks team. Keep the cohort tight and iterate fast. :rocket:
